name: NICE publishes osteoporosis risk guideline
headline: NICE publishes new guideline on assessing fracture risk in adults
summary: NICE published guideline NG259 on 29 July 2026, covering how adults at risk of fragility fractures should be assessed. It replaces an earlier guideline.
keyPoints: NICE published its osteoporosis risk assessment guideline, NG259, on 29 July 2026.
NG259 replaces the earlier guideline CG146 and is the first part of a wider update.
The second part, on treatment and monitoring, is still in development.

body.heading: What was announced
body.body: NICE published a new guideline, Osteoporosis: risk assessment (NG259), on 29 July 2026. It replaces guideline CG146 and is the first part of a wider update. NICE says it covers fragility fracture risk assessment, identifying vertebral fragility fractures, deciding whether drug treatment is appropriate, and follow-up for people not having treatment.

body.heading: What it means
body.body: The second part of the update, on treatment and monitoring, is still in development. A fragility fracture is a broken bone caused by a fall from standing height or less.
